D1.name: Walk-Forward Verification
D1.verdict: Implementation is clean. Determinism verified, WF vs regime delta 0.017, no extreme fold outliers.

D2.name: Transaction Cost Impact
D2.verdict: TC impact is significant (delta 0.5-0.9 SR) but NOT the root cause. Even at TC=0, CTA Full SR=-0.147.

D3.name: Signal Generation Comparison
D3.verdict: Signal generation works correctly. 300 signals on real vs 263 on synthetic over same period.

D4.name: Data Quality Verification
D4.verdict: Data is fundamentally clean across all 3 datasets (CTA Full, CTA COVID, RP Full).

D5.name: Win Rate & Return Distribution
D5.verdict: CRITICAL: ~80% of OOS bars have ZERO return. On non-zero bars, win rate is 53-63% (decent). Negative Sharpe driven by extreme kurtosis (52.9) — a few catastrophic losses dominate.

D6.name: Engine Determinism & Sanity
D6.verdict: Engine is sound. Fully deterministic, handles edge cases gracefully.

root_cause.primary: Strategy signal is structurally weak — 80% zero bars, kurtosis 52.9, negative mean return
root_cause.secondary: Transaction costs amplify the damage but are not the root cause

next_steps: Proceed to Phase B for strategy enhancement or classify as MONITOR only
